NEW DEFECT (H1), nobody has reported it: a `touch`-range spell applies its effect ONCE PER ACTIVE FRAME. `MagicSystem._spawnContact` sets ticksEveryF:1 over the class's whole active window and the volume loop has no per-target dedupe. damage_health magnitude 20 (declared output 40): CANTRIP touch 4 applications / 176 damage, LIGHT touch 5 / 220, HEAVY touch 7 / 308 — against 1 application / 44 damage at `target` and at `projectile`. Touch multiplies every effect by the class's active-frame count. The census and the dials probe both PREFER `touch` (rangeFor order self,touch,target,...), so a large part of the catalogue was measured through a 4-7x applicator.

E1 CONTRADICTS THE BUILDER: absorb_health DOES absorb. Player wounded to 80/300, absorb_health magnitude 60 at touch: player 80 -> 300 (+220, capped), enemy 412 -> 77. damage_health and drain_health both move the caster 0. The builder's 'absorb_health does not absorb' was measured at magnitude 1 in an arena where the caster's hp was already at its cap for the frame it looked at.

E3 CONFIRMS THE BUILDER: frenzy is inert as a behaviour. frenzy_target is written ('e1') and over 1200 f@60 with two bodies 0.7 m apart NEITHER body loses a single hp. hostileTo has exactly one grep hit in the whole build, the write itself.
